description: 🚨 THE IRREVERSIBLE STEP — fans the draft out into the send queue and real mail goes to real people. Confirm with the user before calling it. Returns 202: the rows are enqueued and the pacing engine releases them at the pool's warm-up-aware rate. TWO RESULTS THAT LOOK LIKE FAILURES AND ARE NOT: `already_enqueued > 0` is a RESUMED fan-out (the enqueue is idempotent per broadcast+address, so a retry after an interruption fills only the gaps instead of double-sending), and `provider_configured: false` means the rows are queued and will HOLD until credentials exist — a deliberate dormant state, not an error. Refusals are real, though: 422 no_audience, 422 no_sources, and 503 when the suppression list cannot be read (it fails CLOSED rather than mailing an unchecked list).
